title: The builder-test-edit guard does not read a test run's label words as a test-file edit
why: builder-test-edit refused `MUTATE_ONLY="a copy whose source is in another checkout" python3 hooks/test_guard.py`, a test run only, by reading the words inside the quoted label (lane other-checkout-cp-own ([ended:lane:-other-checkout-cp-own]); coordinator, 04:13 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: the guard reads an env-assignment value as data, not as command words, before it looks for a test-file write. Red case first: that command is refused today; control: a real write to a test file by a builder still refuses. Related done step refusal-stricter-fixes. Owner: lane other-checkout-cp-own, a fix in that lane (coordinator, 04:13 CST Nov 8). Queue fix. Filed 04:20 CST Nov 8. Possible second false alarm (lane notes-fix-large-1, 05:24 CST Nov 8): on PR #1793 (branch env-smart-quote-path, about 03:15 CST), a builder's `sed -i '3s/ now refuse, and have no test case yet\./ refuse./' docs/debts/env-guard-reads-basenames-only.md && grep -c ...` was refused as builder-test-edit, though the target is a debt record. The likely cause is the words "test case" inside the sed script, or a test path in the grep that follows (cut off in the log). The builder made the edit with the Edit tool.
